title: AutoToolSwap
description: Automatically switches to the best tool in your hotbar when you mine or attack. Picks the right tool by tier and enchantment. Optional swap-back.
body:
## AutoToolSwap

Stop manually switching tools. AutoToolSwap detects what you are mining or attacking and equips the best tool.

### What it does
- **Auto tool selection** -- picks optimal tool by block/mob type
- **Tier priority** -- Netherite > Diamond > Iron
- **Enchantment awareness** -- factors in Efficiency, Sharpness
- **Swap-back** -- returns to previous slot after use

### How to use
- Works automatically
- Configure via Mod Menu -> AutoToolSwap

### Compatibility
Client-side only, uses inventory interactions.

## Changelog
### v1.0.0
- Initial release: auto-selects the best hotbar tool for the block you mine or mob you hit, with optional swap-back. Never moves items between slots.
